mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, we are seeing overcast skies and 78 degrees out at Reddan Soccer Park. We are also under a waning crescent moon tonight, and you can spot the international space station in the sky starting at 8:17 PM as it travels from the South Southwest toward the East Northeast, appearing about halfway up the horizon.

In city news, the Verona Fire Department invites you to an open house on September 19 from 10 AM to 2 PM at 101 Lincoln Street. It is a great opportunity to tour the station, meet your local firefighters, and join in on safety demonstrations.

You have plenty of local options for entertainment. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow is also busy with the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, live music, and several more trivia events at places like The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

Regarding local law enforcement, the Verona Police Department announced that on Sunday, August 30, they arrested a 34-year-old individual from Madison following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019.

If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to head over before they close their doors at 10 PM tonight.
